product.title: Haleakala Maui Sunset Twilight Tour with Dinner

description.text: Many visitors summit Maui's Haleakala for the sunrise but you can beat the crowds by visiting for an equally scenic sunset instead. Enjoy the best sunset view on Maui from the island's tallest peak. Stops include Kula Lodge Marketplace, Haleakalā National Park Visitor Center, Haleakala Summit. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Maui's volcanoes, waterfalls, reefs, and cultural landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
